source.sourceWork: MEIKO original Japanese VOCALOID voicebank (2004), original adult box-art avatar; Nostalogic voice role (2008)
source.appearance: Adult illustrated virtual singer with short chestnut-brown bob, original red sleeveless crop-top and short red skirt, brown knee-high boots; no school uniform, derivative child avatar, V3 headset or later ornate costume
source.weapon: Classic stage microphone used for singing, not a weapon
source.pose: Sing into a physically held stage microphone and give a calm musical cue to allies; no weapon, projectile, magical attack, health restoration or source-superpower claim
source.name: Nostalogic — voix de MEIKO

evidence.fact: Official MEIKO character page identifies red crop-top, chestnut-brown hair and first release5November2004; original product is distinct from2014MEIKOV3.
